tasks.title: series: one rigidity test and a reg_matrix text parser
tasks.test_approach: Unit tests of the parser on synthetic matrix texts; the existing REG rigidity tests stay green unchanged.
criteria: The rigidity test of _rigid_matrix (finite, last row 0 0 0 1 within LAST_ROW_ATOL, R^T R = I within RIGID_ATOL, det > 0) lives in one helper that _rigid_matrix calls; every existing test_series.py test passes unchanged

A public parser takes reg_matrix text and returns the 4x4 numpy matrix: the identity matrix for 'identity', the parsed matrix for 16 '%.10g' values that pass the rigidity helper, and None for '', a count other than 16, a non-number, a non-finite value or a non-rigid matrix (each case a test)
The parser round-trips the text series.registration writes for a rotation-plus-translation REG (test via the existing synthetic REG helpers)

tasks.title: check_rows: return and validate the series rows (D12)
tasks.test_approach: Red-first tests on synthetic converted plan folders with kind=series rows; callers updated to the new return shape with no other behaviour change.
criteria: check_rows returns (kept, ct, series), where series holds the kind=series rows in input order; preprocess_plan and manifest are updated to the new return shape; no other output changes in this task
A plan whose series row names a missing file is refused with REASON_FILE_MISSING by preprocess and is counted refused by manifest

A plan whose series row has a modality other than CT, MR or PT is refused with REASON_STUDY_MODALITY; one whose file name series_id rejects is refused with REASON_STUDY_NAME; one whose name carries a different MOD than its modality column is refused with REASON_STUDY_MODALITY
A series file named with step prefixes (e.g. reshape_resample_initialresample_series_MR_1.nii.gz) with modality MR passes check_rows
REASON_STUDY_MODALITY and REASON_STUDY_NAME are reworded to refer to a series.csv series row, so the text fits a plan as well as a study; the constant names are unchanged
check_rows reads no series header: a plan whose kind=series file is present but not a valid NIfTI passes check_rows (test)

Every change to an existing test is listed in findings.md under task-02, including test_series_csv_keeps_every_column_renames_files_and_drops_series_rows (tests/test_preprocess.py), which relied on a missing series file

tasks.title: preprocess: align registered series onto the final CT grid (D1-D9, D13)
tasks.test_approach: Synthetic converted plan folders (CT, dose, mask plus series_MR/series_CT NIfTI written with SimpleITK, series.csv rows with reg_matrix text); landmark tests per spec D11; red first for each criterion.
criteria: AC1: a plan with one registered MR (reg_matrix a translation) under LEGACY_RNT writes the MR with the geometric prefixes on exactly the final CT's size, origin, spacing and direction, float32; the output series.csv lists it after the existing rows with reg_matrix 'identity' and the CT row's frame_of_reference_uid; the plan row's files includes it before series.csv

AC2: landmark tests (a) identity on a different grid, (b) pure translation by a whole number of final-grid voxels, (c) rotation about one axis (not 180 degrees) plus translation. The implementer picks CT and MR geometry so the landmark lies inside the final LEGACY_RNT grid by construction. Expected index: the landmark's physical point in the MR mapped through reg_matrix, converted with TransformPhysicalPointToContinuousIndex on the written output image; the output argmax is within 0.5 + 1e-6 of it per axis. For (b) and (c), the point mapped through the inverse of reg_matrix differs from the expected index by more than one voxel on some axis, and the argmax is more than half a voxel from it on that axis
AC3: final-grid voxels outside the series FOV are 0; a constant-valued MR keeps its value at interior voxels at least one voxel from the series boundary

AC4: a registered CT series under LEGACY_RNT is rescaled before the resample: a constant HU value v lands as (v + 1024) / 4096 at interior voxels, 0 outside, and its output name carries the rescale_ prefix (output_name with ct=True)
AC5: a series with reg_matrix '' and one with a non-rigid matrix are each left out (no output file, no output series.csv row); the plan row is preprocessed with skipped_series 1
AC6: a series translated entirely outside the CT is left out and counted as in AC5; one partly outside is kept
AC7 (preprocess half): an unreadable series file is left out and counted as in AC5; REASON_INTERNAL from the resample still stops the run
AC9: with rescale as the only step, a registered MR series is resampled onto the native CT grid (not copied, not refused) and keeps its input file name
AC10: preprocess_report.csv has a skipped_series column after files; patient, study, study-series and refused plan rows hold 0; the closing log line includes the total
Series skip check_crop and the dose/mask same_grid check; dose, mask and CT outputs of every existing test are unchanged
One series is held at a time: read, resampled, written and released before the next (code review checks the loop shape, as for dose)
Two registered series are written in series.csv input order, after the existing rows, in both the plan row's files and the output series.csv
The no-log-line-carries-a-path test also runs a plan with a registered series, including a skipped one; skip logs carry a fixed REASON_ constant or a count only
Every change to an existing test is listed in findings.md under task-03, including the preprocess_report.csv header pin

tasks.title: manifest: series column of aligned series (D10)
tasks.test_approach: Manifest over a converted tree and over the tree preprocess writes from it, with synthetic MR series; red first.
criteria: COLUMNS gains a last column series: a JSON list of {"file": ..., "modality": ...} for the plan's kind=series rows whose reg_matrix is 'identity' and whose header is on the plan CT's grid (same_grid), in series.csv order

AC11: on a preprocessed tree the aligned MR is listed as [{"file": <output name>, "modality": "MR"}]; on the converted tree a translated MR on its own grid lists [], a translated MR written with the CT's exact geometry plus a translation REG lists [], and an identity MR on the CT grid is listed; imaging rows hold []
A series whose header cannot be read is not listed and does not refuse the plan

AC12: the manifest column tests in test_manifest.py are updated for the new column and every change to an existing test is listed in findings.md; tests/test_plan_regression.py is unchanged; the full suite and ruff pass
README names the series manifest column (JSON list of file and modality, aligned series only) and the skipped_series report column, and no longer says three columns come after the first ten

guardrails: docs/handoffs/hardening-b11-continuation.md and the guardrails it chains to: at most 5 staged files per commit, no dotted private names in added lines (getattr(module, '_name')  # noqa: B009), no raise inside an except block, SYNTHETIC_ test data, no PHI in messages
follow [[sitk-resample-transform-scale-shrinks-targets-by-1-over-s]]: sitk.Resample maps output points to input points, so the transform is the inverse of reg_matrix (spec D2)
follow [[pydicom-validates-lazily-on-first-tag-access]]: any new pydicom read is quieted for the whole access
task-02 and task-03 both change preprocess.py, so they never run in parallel worktrees (max_parallel_worktrees is 1)
